terms.seniorPremium: +0.50% p.a. (60 to below 80 years); not applicable to NRE/NRO deposits
terms.superSeniorPremium: +0.75% p.a. (80 years and above); exempt from the premature-withdrawal penalty; not applicable to NRE/NRO deposits
terms.prematurePenalty: 1% on the rate applicable for the actual holding period; senior and super senior citizens are exempt
other: Fixed deposits booked as 'premature withdrawal not allowed' cannot be withdrawn early except by government/regulatory/legal order or on death of the depositor.
